label: About
title: About Split Crimson J-Card
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 51 recent saved-signal files and 85 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Yuzuru Syogase ‎- 1983-85 (Full Cassette) and Yuzuru Syogase - 1983-1985 album cover, plus 7 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Split Crimson J-Card: Product-photo rupture, side-lit object slab: one impossible-scale crimson cassette J-card stands portrait inside black landscape gutters, split open along a raised left spine. A high upper-right halftone aperture and a lower dark bass ridge carry the plate; broad red silence remains below. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper black halftone rectangle, ragged left release strip, and central torn spine.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
